remarks: Welcome to the iconic Williamsville Towers Condominium! This beautifully renovated 5th-floor residence delivers modern style, incredible natural light and exceptional outdoor living in one impressive package. Featuring 2 bedrooms and 1.5 baths, the updated interior is surrounded by huge windows that flood the space with sunlight and create a bright, open atmosphere throughout. The showstopper is the massive wraparound patio—an incredible extension of the living space with plenty of room for outdoor dining, entertaining, gardening or simply relaxing above it all. Central heating and air conditioning are provided through the building’s HVAC system, with an individual First Co. fan-coil/air-handling system serving the unit. Adding to the convenience, Unit #501 includes both a dedicated parking space and a covered garage space. Garage SBL #69.17-5-30./G17. Set along Main Street in highly sought-after Williamsville, you’re close to the restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques and local destinations that make the Village such a special place to call home. Enjoy Glen Park and Glen Falls, Island Park, the historic Williamsville Water Mill, Lehigh Memory Trail and the vibrant shops and dining throughout the Village. Renovated, sun-filled and positioned in the heart of Williamsville—Unit #501 offers a low-maintenance condominium lifestyle without sacrificing space, outdoor living or location.
